When does New Year 2027 start in Panama?

Panama uses a single time zone on New Year's Eve, UTC-05:00, so the whole country welcomes 2027 at the same moment: midnight local time corresponds to 05:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Panama in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Panama City follows 19 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 6 hours after Panama City.

When the clock strikes midnight in Panama City, 180 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC-04:00): Bolivia, Brazil (Manaus), Canada (Halifax), Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica and 6 more
  • Just after (UTC-06:00): Canada (Winnipeg), Costa Rica, Ecuador (Galápagos Islands), El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico (Mexico City), Nicaragua and 2 more

Who celebrates at the same time as Panama?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC-05:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Panama City: Brazil (Rio Branco), Canada (Toronto), Chile (Easter Island), Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador (Quito), Mexico (Cancún), Peru, United States (New York), Bahamas, Haiti and Jamaica.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Panama in UTC?

Midnight in Panama City corresponds to 05:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027.

How many time zones does Panama have on New Year's Eve?

One. The whole country uses UTC-05:00 on New Year's Eve.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Panama on New Year's Eve?

No. Panama City keeps UTC-05:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Panama?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC-04:00, which includes Bolivia, Brazil (Manaus), Canada (Halifax), Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica and 6 more.
